column4: Virology and Vaccine Institute of the Philippines (formerly Virology and Vaccine Research Program)
column8: The project is envisioned to serve as the premier research and development institute in the field of virology, encompassing all areas in viruses and viral diseases in humans, plants, and animals. The VIP project is envisioned to serve as a venue for scientists, both local and international, to work collaboratively to study viruses of agricultural, industrial, clinical, and environmental importance.
